description: This file defines the 'Parser' class which provides core functionality for parsing PDF documents, including reading objects, dictionaries, arrays, streams, cross-reference tables, and handling indirect objects within a PDF file. It interacts with various internal components such as lexer, object references, and document trailer, to interpret the structure of a PDF.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A sealed class that provides functionality to parse PDF documents, including reading objects, dictionaries, streams, and trailers. It manages lexer position, object references, object streams, and trailer parsing mechanisms.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing PDF files, including locating 'startxref', reading cross-reference tables and streams, trailers, and object references.

methods.name: MoveToObject
methods.description: Sets the lexer position to the specified object ID within the PDF, with optional error suppression.

methods.name: ReadObjectNumber
methods.description: Reads the object number and generation number from the current lexer position and returns as a PdfObjectID.

methods.name: ReadObjectInternal
methods.description: Internal method that reads a PDF object from input stream, handling arrays, dictionaries, streams, and primitive types based on tokens.

methods.name: ReadArray
methods.description: Reads and constructs a PdfArray object from the input stream.

methods.name: ReadDictionary
methods.description: Reads and constructs a PdfDictionary object from the input stream.

methods.name: ReadDictionaryStream
methods.description: Reads the content of a stream associated with a dictionary, between 'stream' and 'endstream'.

methods.name: GetStreamLength
methods.description: Determines the length of a stream from the dictionary's /Length entry or by analyzing the stream content.

methods.name: TryReadEndStream
methods.description: Attempts to read the 'endstream' keyword after stream data based on the expected length.

methods.name: ReadTrailer
methods.description: Reads the cross-reference table and trailer dictionary from the PDF.

methods.name: ReadTrailer
methods.description: Reads cross-reference tables and trailers, following 'startxref' to locate the trailer, and handling incremental updates.

methods.name: ReadXRefTableAndTrailer
methods.description: Reads a cross-reference table or stream, constructs object references, and retrieves trailer data.

methods.name: CheckXRefTableEntry
methods.description: Validates entries in the cross-reference table to ensure correct object ID and generation number.

methods.name: ReadXRefStream
methods.description: Reads and processes a cross-reference stream, constructing object references from stream entries.

methods.name: ParseDateTime
methods.description: Parses a PDF date string into a DateTime object, handling both PDF-specific and standard formats.

methods.name: SaveState
methods.description: Saves the current parser state including lexer position and symbol.

methods.name: RestoreState
methods.description: Restores the parser state from a saved snapshot.
